newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf winter wheat, corn and soybean basis values were mostly unchanged Monday amid light dealings, grain dealers said.
Egypt's purchase of 200,000 tonnes of soft red winter wheat for June shipment did not prompt changes in FOB offers, nor did it change CIF offers early Monday.
Iraq was scheduled to tender Tuesday for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the recent United Nations food-for-oil deal.
